name: Royal Apothecary Society
summary: Beneath the Undercity, the Royal Apothecary Society works under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. Its Forsaken researchers seek a New Plague to destroy the Scourge and avenge themselves on the living. They tell Horde allies they seek a cure for undeath, while agents gather venoms, slimes, and toxic reagents across Azeroth.

sections.title: Vengeance Through Alchemy
sections.body:
After the Forsaken won their freedom, the Royal Apothecary Society became the scientific and alchemical arm of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner's kingdom. In the Apothecarium's vats and underground laboratories, researchers try to turn the force that damned them into a weapon. Their chief work is a New Plague meant to eradicate the Scourge and destroy the Lich King.

Human alchemists often pursue healing draughts or transmutation. The Society experiments with pathogens, caustic acids, and necromantic mixtures. Its alchemists also raise fallen warhorses as skeletal steeds and brew ever deadlier strains of toxic blight.

sections.title: A Calculated Deception
sections.body:
The Royal Apothecary Society tells its allies in Orgrimmar and Thunder Bluff that its alchemists seek a remedy for undeath. The claim makes its members seem like misunderstood scholars laboring for their people. Master Apothecary Faranell and the dark council have little interest in curing the affliction.

In secret, the Society refines toxins that spare no one. Its researchers test them on living and undead subjects to ensure their enemies can be annihilated.

sections.title: Outposts Across Azeroth
sections.body:
The Apothecary Society sends its work far beyond the Undercity's canals. Field apothecaries serve at remote outposts across Lordaeron and Kalimdor. In Silverpine and Hillsbrad, Apothecaries Renferrel and Lydon gather local plants and distill venoms. In the arid Barrens, Apothecary Helbrim catalogs strange desert plants and creatures.

Apothecary Zamah works beneath Thunder Bluff in the Pools of Vision. The Society sends acolytes wherever natural toxins, shifting oozes, or virulent organisms can be found. They collect samples for the Apothecarium's cauldrons.

faq.q: What is the Royal Apothecary Society?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society is the Forsaken alchemical order based in the Apothecarium beneath the Undercity. Founded under Queen Sylvanas Windrunner, its members study pathogens, necromancy, and toxic reagents to make weapons for the Forsaken.

faq.q: What is the New Plague they are working on?
faq.answer: The New Plague is an alchemical pathogen the Society develops under Sylvanas's direct orders. It is meant to destroy the Scourge and the Lich King, while remaining lethal to living beings who threaten the Forsaken.

faq.q: Does the Horde know what the Society is really brewing?
aliases: does thrall know about the plague
do orcs know about the plague
faq.answer: No. The Forsaken tell their Horde allies they seek a remedy for undeath and a peaceful place for their people. Tauren and Orcs believe the apothecaries pursue a cure, unaware that the Society is making a weapon of annihilation.

faq.q: Who leads the Royal Apothecary Society?
faq.answer: Queen Sylvanas Windrunner holds authority over the Royal Apothecary Society. Master Apothecary Faranell and other senior overseers direct its daily scientific work and research in the Undercity.

faq.q: Why are apothecaries stationed in places like the Barrens or Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: Field apothecaries seek biological agents, exotic venom, fungi, and mutagenic oozes that Lordaeron lacks. Helbrim in the Crossroads and Zamah in Thunder Bluff study local life and send dangerous samples to the Undercity laboratories.

faq.q: How does the Society create Forsaken mounts?
aliases: where do undead horses come from
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society uses dark alchemy and necromancy to raise fallen warhorses as skeletal mounts for Forsaken riders in battle.

angles.text: As an undead, your people turn the plague that butchered Lordaeron into an instrument of vengeance against the Scourge and all who oppose you.
As a member of the Horde, you hear Forsaken representatives say their alchemical work seeks a cure for undeath. Their cauldrons in the Apothecarium hide more deadly aims.
As a herbalist, you know the Society prizes deadly plants, gathering toxic fungi, stranglekelp, and grave moss across Azeroth for its cauldrons.
As a tauren, you know your elders allowed Apothecary Zamah into the Pools of Vision out of pity for the cursed dead. They believed the Forsaken sought a cure for their affliction.
